jcr:content.title: Meet our Employees

text.text:
Have you ever tried to explain your job in 15 seconds? It is actually no easy task. We gave it a try and took our employees on a lift ride and asked them why their work matters.

Why do we think it's important to let AbbVie employees talk about themselves? Because it is precisely their work that has a tangible and lasting impact on patients. We use our expertise, resources, and talent to make a real difference. And we're always looking for new talent to join us.

Florian Krummenacher
Market Access Manager

Florian plays a crucial role in bringing innovative medicines to patients. Check out more about his role and what makes him happy outside of working hours.

Bea Amgarten
Regulatory Affairs Manager

What does the job of Regulatory Affairs Manager include? Meet Bea, Regulatory Affairs Manager and her dog Linus, that brings more balance in her life.

text_copy_copy.text:
Tobias Kaspar
Patient Relations Manager 

Tobias works with patient organizations on various projects to improve our understanding of patient needs. An exciting and varied job that requires not only communication skills, but also empathy.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Patrizia Ciuta
Digital Transformation Manager

Patrizia is among the most curious employees at AbbVie Switzerland! With her progressive and inspiring attitude, she takes literally everyone on her journey. Even though everything appears to be digital, Patrizia's love for the analog world remains strong.

text_copy.text:
Aline Commend
Brand Account Manager Hematology

As sales manager at AbbVie, Aline knows the drugs she takes care of inside out. She is the point of contact for doctors and answers their questions about related indications. And as a proud “Vaudoise”, she has a flair for local traditions.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Benjamin Stöcklin
Brand Manager

Meet Benjamin, Brand Manager at AbbVie Switzerland, and learn more about his fascinating role and where he channels his energy beyond regular working hours.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Nicole Lüscher
Quality Manager

Meet Nicole, the Quality Manager at AbbVie Switzerland, and learn more about her role and the different standards she upholds in her free time.

text_copy.text:
Andra Korb
Talent Acquisition Manager

Meet Andra, our Talent Acquisition Manager, who is continually seeking the most talented individuals to join us. Discover what “doing things right” means to her, both in her professional and personal life.

text_copy_copy.text:
Giona Pedrioli
Medical Advisor Specialty Care

Meet Giona, a Medical Advisor at AbbVie Switzerland. Find out what his job entails and what he does when he's not talking to doctors.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Sira Gisler
Learning Manager

Meet Sira, our Learning Manager, and discover her innovative approach to learning development in teams and insights into her family life.

text_copy.text:
Leonhard von Meyenn
Senior Medical Science Liaison Gastroenterology 

Meet Leonhard, the Senior Medical Science Liaison, who serves the medical community by sharing in-depth scientific knowledge. Action defines him, both professionally and personally.

text_copy_copy.text:
Maija Skatar
Executive Assistant 

Meet Maija, the executive assistant, who effectively uses communication tools to ensure good collaboration within the company. Discover her take on culture and her passion for speed.
